root_cause.text: The vulnerability stems from the lack of validation on the variable-length SID subauthority count (`num_subauth`) in inherited ACEs when processing a parent directory's DACL, allowing a malformed ACE to advertise more subauthorities than present, which leads to out-of-bounds reads during SID comparison and buffer overflow during inherited ACE size calculation.

candidates.rationale: Directly uses sid->num_subauth without validation to compute ACE size, allowing oversized allocation from malformed SID.
Copies the parent SID into the inherited ACE without validating num_subauth, leading to downstream exploitation of the malformed SID.
Adds the unchecked ACE size (derived from unvalidated num_subauth) to nt_size, causing buffer overflow when allocating the final DACL.
Advances the pointer into the inherited ACE list by an unchecked size, enabling out-of-bounds read/write during subsequent ACE processing.
Second occurrence of unchecked size addition to nt_size (in the else branch), further contributing to allocation overflow.
Second occurrence of pointer advancement by unchecked size, amplifying out-of-bounds risk.
Computes the group SID size using unvalidated num_subauth, leading to undersized allocation of pntsd and subsequent overflow when copying SID data.

vuln_statements.explanation: Directly uses sid->num_subauth without validation to compute ACE size, allowing oversized allocation from a malformed SID with an inflated subauthority count, leading to heap buffer overflow.
Copies the parent SID into the inherited ACE without validating num_subauth, preserving the malformed subauthority count and enabling subsequent out-of-bounds reads during SID comparison.
Adds the unchecked ACE size (derived from unvalidated num_subauth) to nt_size, causing buffer overflow when allocating the final DACL because the size can be arbitrarily large.
Advances the pointer into the inherited ACE list by an unchecked size, enabling out-of-bounds read/write during subsequent ACE processing if the specified size exceeds the actual buffer.
Computes the group SID size using unvalidated num_subauth, leading to undersized allocation of pntsd and subsequent heap buffer overflow when copying SID data.
